{{Quote|Instead, you decide to stop off on this ''garbage world'', slam in the middle of Empire-held territory, and line your pockets by smuggling...|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="TPE" />}}
'''Attahox''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] near [[Daalang/Legends|Daalang]].

During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] came from [[Ulda Frav]] and conquered the planet before continuing on to [[Nixor/Legends|Nixor]].<ref name="TEA" />

By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Attahox was known as a garbage planet, and had been used for centuries by criminal gangs as a hideout and cache. Archaeologists sifted through the refuse in search of lost secrets.<ref name="Filthy Business">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Filthy Business}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Attahox was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />

As of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Attahox was known as a stinking, impoverished, and corrupt planet that served as the base of operations for the [[Torgaigne|Exalted Torgaigne]] crime syndicate. The Torgaigne controlled the local trade in [[phosovane salts]], which were used in painkillers on [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rim worlds]].<ref name="TPE" />

As part of its efforts to economically revitalize [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] planets in [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]] region, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] funded a colony on Attahox to search for resources previous strip miners had overlooked.<ref>[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook]]</ref>
